desc:
Welcome to Skegness, England Beta! 🌿

Owned by Sam (@starsamzs) and Jayden (@jxydenluau) ❗

We are the updated and refreshed version of Lincolnshire, England on Roblox. Explore our realistic roads based on the real life village of Burgh Le Marsh in Lincolnshire, whilst driving our 1-1 accurate vehicles. 🗺️

Update Change-Log:
5 New Vehicles 🚗
Halloween Event Removed 🎃
Bug Fixes 🐛

Console Controls:
L1 - Left Indicator
R1 - Right Indicator
L3 - Flash
Right D-Pad - Hazards
Left D-Pad - Horn
Bottom D-Pad - Lights
Top D-Pad - Enable Cruise Control
